source: Kansas City Zoning and Development Code, Chapter 88, Sections 88-130-05 and 88-130-06

rules.condition: Divide total gross floor area by lot area. The resulting floor area ratio must not exceed 15.0.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2

rules.rule: DC-15 single-purpose residential minimum lot area per dwelling unit: 100 sq ft
rules.condition: For a single-purpose residential building, divide lot area by dwelling-unit count. The result must be at least 100 square feet per dwelling unit. This minimum does not apply to residential units above the ground floor in a mixed-use building.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2

rules.rule: DC-15 has no base maximum building height
rules.condition: Do not apply a base-district height cap under Table 130-2. Independently evaluate any mapped airport-height restriction, overlay, approved development plan, or site-specific ordinance returned for the parcel.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2

rules.rule: DC-15 front setback when abutting a residential district
rules.condition: If the lot abuts an R-zoned lot with frontage on the same street, the front setback must match the existing building setback on that R-zoned lot. If no building exists there, provide at least 50% of the front setback required for that R-zoned lot. Otherwise, no base front setback applies.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2 note 1

rules.rule: DC-15 rear setback when abutting a residential district
rules.condition: If the rear lot line abuts an R-zoned district, the rear setback must equal 25% of lot depth, capped at 30 feet. Otherwise, no base rear setback applies.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2

rules.rule: DC-15 side setback when abutting a residential district
rules.condition: If a side lot line abuts an R-zoned lot, provide the same side setback required for that abutting R-zoned lot. Otherwise, no base side setback applies.
rules.source: KCMO Zoning and Development Code 88-130-05, Table 130-2 note 2

rules.rule: Downtown new-construction ground-floor ceiling height minimum: 13 ft
rules.condition: For new construction in a D district, nonresidential and nonparking ground-floor space must have a floor-to-ceiling height of at least 13 feet. Rehabilitation and renovation projects are excluded.

rules.rule: Downtown ground-floor commercial area for frontage under 50 ft
rules.condition: For applicable new construction with lot frontage under 50 feet, qualifying ground-floor commercial space must be at least the greater of 800 square feet or 25% of lot area.

rules.rule: Downtown ground-floor commercial area for frontage of 50 ft or more
rules.condition: For applicable new construction with lot frontage of at least 50 feet, qualifying ground-floor commercial space must be at least 20% of lot area.

rules.rule: One principal building per lot unless otherwise approved
rules.condition: The lot may contain only one principal building and customary accessory uses unless an approval authorizes additional principal buildings.
